papers.title: LLM2R: From Large Language Models to 3D Reassemblers
papers.summary: LLM2R treats 3D part assembly as sequence modeling with a pretrained decoder-only LLM, using geometric tokens and learnable summary tokens to predict all part poses in a single pass with improved scalability and accuracy.

papers.title: Joints, Camera, Action! Co-Generating 3D Motion and Video for Arbitrary Rigs
papers.summary: The model co-generates video and 3D motion for arbitrary skeletons via cross-attention with a pretrained video generator, enabling scene-registered animation and bidirectional video-motion conversion.

papers.title: Specter: Fast MoE Inference via Quantization-Enabled Multi-Step Speculative Offloading
papers.summary: Specter accelerates single-GPU mixture-of-experts inference by combining quantized speculative decoding with expert offloading to hide PCIe latency and improve throughput.

papers.title: SpecKCast: Spectral Kalman Forecasting for Diffusion Acceleration
papers.summary: SpecKCast forecasts diffusion transformer outputs in the frequency domain using per-band Kalman filters and adaptive step scheduling to accelerate inference with minimal memory overhead.

papers.title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
papers.summary: Agent S4 autonomously evolves computer-use interfaces from task experience, significantly improving open-source agent performance and reducing costs compared to larger proprietary models.

papers.title: Painting Change Map as guidance for generating painting processes
papers.summary: This work introduces a spatio-temporal Painting Change Map to control video generation of artwork by tracking localized structural changes across time, enabling fine-grained guidance for painting and unpainting processes.

papers.title: FlowState: Execution State as Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.summary: FlowState improves long-horizon agent performance by maintaining structured, revisitable execution memory with incremental updates and progressive access, reducing token use while increasing success rates.

papers.title: Event-STVG: Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding for Long-Form Event Reasoning
papers.summary: Event-STVG introduces a challenging benchmark requiring multimodal models to perform long-form event reasoning, repeated-event disambiguation, and multi-target spatio-temporal grounding across extended video contexts.

papers.title: Epi: Towards a Persistent, Self-Improving Agent for Autonomous Research
papers.summary: Épi is an autonomous research agent that maintains persistent investigations across sessions, improves through accumulated experience, and achieves record-setting mathematical and algorithmic results with reduced computational cost.

papers.title: EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents
papers.summary: EAU is a meta-agent framework that co-evolves the user simulator, environment, and reinforcement learning setup alongside the policy to improve multi-turn LLM agent training.

papers.title: Unsupervised Tool Evolution for Coding Agents in Data-Lake Analytics
papers.summary: TEAL evolves reusable data-analysis tools for coding agents without ground-truth labels by combining data-driven exploration and trajectory-based critique, improving accuracy under tight step budgets.

papers.title: Evaluating Agentic Capabilities Before Post-Training: An End-to-End Approach
papers.summary: ASAP is a lightweight framework that evaluates agentic behavior in pretrained base models via interactive end-to-end tasks without converting them to chat agents.

papers.title: On the Fragility of Tasks under Composition: Implicit Budgeting in Language Models
papers.summary: Modern language models are increasingly asked to handle several tasks within a single prompt. Doing so requires solving each task correctly while integrating the resulting answers into a coherent response. In this paper, we identify a fundamental limitation in this process, where models make…

papers.title: PVBench: Quantifying Physical Plausibility in Video Generation with Object-Level Physical Measurements
papers.summary: PVBench introduces a quantitative benchmark with 46 physical dimensions to evaluate the plausibility of generated videos using specialized vision models and human-aligned metrics.

papers.title: Muse Glimmer 30B: An On-Device Agentic Model
papers.summary: Muse Glimmer is a 30B-parameter open-source causal language model with a perception encoder that performs multi-step reasoning and tool use locally on consumer hardware via 4-bit quantization.

papers.title: λ_0: Scaling Open-World Egocentric Human Data for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.summary: HumanVerse pairs egocentric video with synchronized body and hand motion to train a humanoid foundation model for whole-body loco-manipulation via human-to-robot transfer without target-task robot demonstrations.

papers.title: Training the Whole Agent, Not Just the Model
papers.summary: HarnessAdapt-RL jointly trains a coding policy and adapts its evaluation harness via mechanism-level skills and evolving tools, improving benchmark pass rates over fixed-harness reinforcement learning.

papers.title: OverSeer: Multi-Agent World Models Beyond What Agents See
papers.summary: OverSeer improves multi-agent world models by adding fixed auxiliary camera views that stabilize consistency and are compressed via delta-VAE to reduce computation.

papers.title: OmniCam: Omni-Camera Trajectory Generation via Geometry-Grounded Pose Token Learning
papers.summary: OmniCam is an autoregressive model that generates camera pose sequences from panoramas and text, using geometric and target-aware conditioning to improve trajectory accuracy and reduce collisions.

papers.title: Multimodal Reranking Is a System One Decision
papers.summary: A general vision-language model can serve as a multimodal reranker via single-pass choice questions, matching or exceeding dedicated rerankers with minimal tuning.

papers.title: Self-Credit: Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Agentic RL via Intra-group Rescaling
papers.summary: LLM agents are commonly trained with RLVR, but the sparse nature of typical RLVR rewards makes credit assignment challenging, especially for long-horizon tasks. We propose Self-Credit, an end-to-end agentic RL method that creates dense supervision signals from sparse outcome rewards using…

papers.title: Slot-JEPA: Object-Structured Prediction Interfaces for Latent World Models
papers.summary: Slot-JEPA decomposes dense representations into reusable semantic slots and spatial masks to improve predictive modeling, planning, and transfer across visual tasks.

papers.title: HRoPE: Homography Relative Positional Encoding
papers.summary: HRoPE introduces surface-aware positional encoding using slanted 3D planes and homographies to improve cross-view alignment and novel view synthesis without requiring ground-truth geometry.

papers.title: PhysLDM: Latent Diffusion for High-Fidelity Deformable Simulation
papers.summary: PhysLDM introduces a spatiotemporal latent diffusion framework for high-fidelity deformable body simulation, using a holistic VAE and diffusion to model chaotic dynamics and enable zero-shot generalization.

papers.title: On the Limits of Scale: Inverse Scaling in Vision-Language Models
papers.summary: Vision-language models show inverse scaling on specific subtasks, where larger versions underperform smaller ones in areas like spatial reasoning and STEM questions, indicating that model choice should be task-specific.

papers.title: On the Tip of the Tongue: First-Token Cueing as a Behavioral Probe of Recall Failures in LLMs
papers.summary: Many factual errors in large language models stem from failing to generate the correct first token of an answer, and providing that token allows the model to complete and recognize the correct response.

papers.title: BiDex-100: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Across 100+ Simulation Tasks
papers.summary: BiDex-100 is a simulation benchmark for bimanual dexterous manipulation that evaluates vision-language-action models across diverse tasks, robustness variants, and demonstration scales.

papers.title: Axiomatic World Modeling for Physics Reasoning
